label: Teltonika RUTX10 (EOL)
description: The enterprise wired router: 1 WAN (reconfigurable as LAN) + 3 LAN at gigabit, dual-band 802.11ac Wave 2 Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE, with no cellular modem.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUTX10 datasheet: 1x WAN port (can be configured as LAN) 10/100/1000 Mbps and 3x LAN ports 10/100/1000 Mbps; Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n/ac Wave 2 (Wi-Fi 5) dual band at up to 867 Mbps with MU-MIMO, plus Bluetooth LE. No cellular modem.
